about: The source model of an MP4 or QuickTime file (spec/virtualize/mp4.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mp4.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, and the roles the file, each box, the movie, each table and each track play, with the constraints a file must meet to have the MP4 convention's layout (spec/virtualize/mp4.md §19.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mp4.md#191-boxes>). The parser checks them in this order; whether a track is virtualized is no constraint (a track the profile does not virtualize is recorded with the reason), and projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of an MP4 file. Every box is a struct named by its type (spec/virtualize/mp4.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mp4.md#53-elements> says how a repeated or unusual type is named), whose extent is the box; T is a track's index among the moov box's trak boxes, j a sample's index in decode order.

<box>/fields.type: a record of the box's fixed fields (spec/virtualize/mp4.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/mp4.md#2-boxes>)

<box>/entries.type: the box's table, an array of numbers or records

<box>/data.type: bytes[n]: the payload of a box the convention does not parse, opaque

<box>/rest.type: bytes[n]: bytes after a box's fields, table or children that are none of them

samples/<T>/<j>.form: {geometry, codec: {name: the sample entry's type, format}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}

gaps/<offset>.about: bytes no box header, value or sample claims: the media data that is in no sample
